VI.description: REFERENCE COPY of bats.parser.vi\2C built 2026-10-14 from its AIXML export. The two FPGA FIFO Write nodes (handshake interface)\2C which AIXML cannot carry\2C are replaced by calls to FIFO.WRITE.vi with the FIFO's configuration wired as constants\3A FIFO Name and Data Type\2C Element through To Variant. Everything else is the exported diagram; typedefs come back as bare clusters (rebind if this is ever used for real). To put the real FIFO nodes back\3A replace each FIFO.WRITE.vi call with the FPGA FIFO Method Node (Write) for the named FIFO\2C wire Element and Input Valid\2C read Ready for Input\2C delete the constants and To Variant.
